Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instructions to confirm Eldon’s county and obtain corroborating sources. Instead, it repeatedly reopened the Lloyd Dane page and did not open the Eldon, Missouri page again or any authoritative sources (despite search results indicating “Eldon Genealogy (in Miller County, MO)”). This noncompliance prevented confirming that Eldon is in Miller County and led to an unresolved/incorrect county determination.
